 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'IMMUTABLE_HISTORY' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hb_obligation_before(a uuid, b uuid, owner_id uuid, acct uuid, k bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT hb_position_before(a,b,owner_id,acct,k)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hb_obligation_snapshot(e obligation_events)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',1,'revisionId',e.id,'obligationId',e.obligation_id,
 'originatingPeriodId',o.originating_period_id,'fundingPeriodId',e.funding_period_id,'title',e.title,'dueDate',e.due_date,
 'originalCents',e.original_cents::text,'outstandingCents',e.outstanding_cents::text,
 'status',e.status,'isPossible',e.is_possible,'reserveFull',e.reserve_full)
 FROM obligations o WHERE o.id=e.obligation_id AND o.owner_user_id=e.owner_user_id AND o.account_id=e.account_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hb_proposal_lock()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM accounts WHERE id=NEW.account_id AND owner_user_id=NEW.owner_user_id FOR UPDATE;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hb_saving_snapshot(e savings_events)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',1,'revisionId',e.id,'savingsId',e.savings_id,
 'originatingPeriodId',g.originating_period_id,'fundingPeriodId',e.funding_period_id,'title',e.title,
 'amountCents',e.amount_cents::text,'status',e.status)
 FROM savings_goals g WHERE g.id=e.savings_id AND g.owner_user_id=e.owner_user_id AND g.account_id=e.account_id
$function$
